informal_statement: Real containment in the rational interval after endpoint casting.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At LeanSuffixReflective.lean:30-33, the source contract is `def RealContains (i : QInterval) (x : ℝ) : Prop := (i.lo : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ (i.hi : ℝ)`.
